hints.name: What the application is called. The banner and the browser tab both use it.
hints.slug: The address: /application/<slug>. Derived from the name until you edit it.
hints.tagline: One line under the banner. What this is, in a breath.
hints.summary: {{count}}/{{max}} · a short blurb for listings and link previews.
hints.featured: Pinned applications can be highlighted wherever the site lists them.
hints.banner: Wide artwork shown above the tab bar. It is never cropped, so any shape works.
hints.icon: Square mark, for cards and social previews.
hints.accent: Hex, like #A855F7. Tints the active tab and the version badges.
hints.version: Free text: 2.6.4, v3, 2026.1 or 1.0-beta all work. No spaces or slashes.
hints.released_at: The day this version shipped — not the day you wrote this up. It is what the tab sorts by.
hints.wiki_title: What the page is called in the sidebar.
hints.wiki_slug: The address inside the wiki. Derived from the title until you edit it.
hints.wiki_icon: An icon name the site resolves, like book-open. Not a URL.
hints.parent: Leave it at the top level, or hang this page under a section.
hints.parent_locked: This page has pages under it, so it cannot itself be nested.
hints.pricing_free: Nothing is charged and no payment is ever offered.
hints.pricing_donation: The builds are free to take. Everybody who has not paid is offered the payment, and told outright that they can decline and download anyway.
hints.pricing_paid: Every build needs an approved purchase on the account — the new releases and the archive alike.
hints.price_amount: What one purchase costs. A paid application without a price cannot open a checkout.
hints.suggested_amount: What the payment dialog prefills. It is a suggestion, not a floor: a smaller amount is still accepted.

list.title: Application pages
list.description: A product page for each application, all to the same shape: a banner, then the tabs you turn on.
list.search_placeholder: Search by name, slug or tagline
list.caption: Application pages
list.empty_description: Create one and it gets the house layout: a banner, a tab bar, and the tabs you choose behind it.
list.delete_body: “{{name}}” will be deleted, and so will every release note and wiki page it holds. This cannot be undone — archiving it instead hides the page without losing the text.

editor.description_new: A name is all it takes to start. Everything else can be filled in as you go.
editor.description_edit: The page itself. Its release notes and its wiki have screens of their own.
editor.identity_hint: What the application is called and where it answers.
editor.appearance_hint: The artwork and the accent. Everything else about the layout is the same on every page here, on purpose.
editor.tabs_hint: Which sections this page shows under its banner. Overview is always on.
editor.links_hint: The buttons under the banner: the repository, the stores, the community.
editor.overview_hint: One centred document. What this is, and why anyone would want it.
editor.contact_hint: How to reach support. The links above are repeated under it, so this is only the text.
editor.contact_placeholder: Open an issue, or find us on Discord.

status_hint.draft: Not visible on the site. Its releases and wiki are hidden with it.
status_hint.published: Live at its address, along with whichever of its tabs are published.
status_hint.archived: Taken down, but nothing is lost.

editor.publish_body: “{{name}}” will be readable by anyone at /application/{{slug}}.
editor.delete_body: “{{name}}” will be deleted, and so will every release note and wiki page it holds. This cannot be undone.
editor.translations_description: The fields above are the {{locale}} version. Anything left blank here falls back to it, so a partly translated page still renders.
editor.translations_none: This service publishes a single language, so there is nothing to translate.
editor.translations_source_empty: Nothing written above to translate yet.
editor.pricing_hint: Whether this application is free, takes an optional payment, or has to be bought before its builds can be downloaded.
editor.pricing_downloads_hint: Payments and downloads are tied to an account on this site: the buyer signs in first, and the licence stays on their account. Downloads are served by the API against a one-off link, never straight from storage.

links.empty: No links yet. The banner shows whatever you add here.
links.label: Label

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: The changelog of {{name}}, newest release first.
updates.caption: Release notes
updates.empty_description: Each entry carries a version, the day it shipped, and links to wherever it can be downloaded.
updates.release_hint: The version, when it shipped, and what to call it.
updates.notes_hint: What changed. A short list beats a paragraph.
updates.body_placeholder:
- Added support for …
- Fixed an issue where …
updates.links_hint: Where this particular version can be had: the GitHub release, the store listing, a direct download.
updates.version_invalid: A version cannot contain spaces or slashes — it is part of the address.

status_hint.draft: Not on the Updates tab yet.
status_hint.published: On the tab. Published without a date, it is dated now.
status_hint.archived: Taken off the tab, but kept.

updates.delete_body: The notes for {{version}} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

wiki.title: Wiki
wiki.description: The documentation of {{name}}, in the order the sidebar shows it.
wiki.caption: Wiki pages
wiki.unknown_section: A section that is no longer here
wiki.empty_description: The first page is the one a reader lands on, so it is usually the overview.
wiki.editor_description: One page of the wiki, and where it sits in the sidebar.
wiki.page_hint: What it is called, where it answers, and which section it belongs to.
wiki.body_placeholder:
## Getting started

Drop the jar in your plugins folder.

status_hint.archived: Taken out of the sidebar, but kept.

wiki.delete_body: “{{title}}” will be deleted. Any pages nested under it are moved back to the top level rather than deleted with it.

translations.title: Translations
translations.description: The fields above are the {{locale}} version. Anything left blank here falls back to it.
translations.none: This service publishes in one language, so there is nothing to translate.

files.title: Downloads
files.hint: The builds this release publishes. They are served by the API against a one-off link, so whether a visitor may take one depends on the application's pricing.
files.empty: This release has no builds attached.
files.publish_blocked: Upload the file before publishing it.
files.naming: The filename is what a visitor saves, and it is taken from the file you upload. To rename it, upload the file under the name it should have.
files.delete_body: {{filename}} and its bytes are removed for good. Anybody linking to it gets a 404.

sales.title: Sales
sales.description: What {{name}} took in, how it arrived, and what went back out.
sales.caption: Sales of this application
sales.empty_description: Payments taken through MercadoPago land here on their own. A sale taken in cash, by transfer or given away is recorded by hand.

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: Computed over exactly the sales listed below, not over the page of them shown.
totals.net_hint: What arrived, less what went back.

record.title: Record a sale
record.body: For money that arrived somewhere this service cannot see: cash, a bank transfer, or a copy given away. It is written as an approved payment and entitles its recipient to the downloads exactly as a card payment does.
record.email_hint: Where the receipt goes, and what the sale is filed under.
record.source_hint: MercadoPago is not offered: a row claiming it took money it has no record of would be indistinguishable from a real payment.
record.amount_hint: Whole pesos. Leave it at zero for a gift.
record.kind_hint: A purchase grants the licence; a donation records support.
record.occurred_at_hint: The statutory ten days run from this date, not from today.
record.reference_hint: A transfer id, so the sale can be matched to a bank statement.
record.note_hint: Which stand, which transfer, who the copy was for.
record.locale_hint: The language the voucher is written in.
record.sent_failed: The sale and its voucher were recorded, but the receipt could not be emailed. Use Resend on the sale.

detail.title: Sale
detail.description: The payment, its receipts, and what can still be done to it.
detail.edit_description: The three things that can be wrong about the world rather than about the sale. The amount, the status and the dates are not editable — correcting one of those is a refund and a new sale.
detail.email_hint: Where a re-issued receipt would go. Changing it sends nothing by itself.
detail.note_hint: Yours, not the buyer's. It never appears on a receipt.

refund.title: Refund this sale
refund.body: A card payment goes back through MercadoPago; one taken in cash or by transfer goes back the way it arrived and this records that it did. The download ends either way.
refund.reason_hint: The right of withdrawal is the buyer's, unconditionally, for ten days. It is kept apart from the rest so it stays countable.
refund.amount_hint: Leave it empty to refund the whole sale ({{amount}}).
refund.blocked_status: Only an approved sale can be refunded.
refund.blocked_environment: This sale was taken against the other MercadoPago account, so this service cannot refund it.

vouchers.title: Receipts
vouchers.description: Every voucher {{name}} ever issued, void ones included.
vouchers.panel_description: A voucher is never edited: correcting one issues the next and voids this one.
vouchers.caption: Vouchers
vouchers.issue_send_failed: The voucher was issued but could not be emailed.
vouchers.send_body: Emails the receipt again. Sending it to another address does not change the voucher — correcting who it was issued to is a re-issue.
vouchers.send_to_hint: Defaults to the address it was issued to.
vouchers.empty_description: A voucher is issued automatically when a payment is approved, and by hand for a sale recorded here.
vouchers.list_empty_description: Vouchers appear here as sales are settled and receipts are issued.
